summary.en: Yoshiaki Kamata lives with his father Hajime; his younger brother Mitsumasa; and his wife Sachiko. Even though all of the three have their own dispute with Yoshiaki, they were genuinely worried when he had not come down for his breakfast, so they went to his room and broke the door because it was locked inside. However, they only found him dead with a knife on him, and the room was quite messy.

victims.name: Yoshiaki Kamata
victims.causeOfDeath: Blood loss caused by a stab wound to the back

suspects: Hajime Kamata, Sachiko Kamata, Mitsumasa Kamata, and Keiko Mitamura
